model.description: The published H2 parameterization of the homogeneous-fluid residual EOS, constructed with ZhangDuanEOS.from_species(('H2',)) and composition [1].

conditions: T > 0 in K and P > 0 in Pa; scalar state inputs and composition [1].
phase is vapor, selecting the first mechanically stable low-density-branch root.

limitations.statement: The vapor selector does not prove vapor stability. Phase separation, reaction speciation and dissociation are outside this homogeneous EOS.
